Definition
[adjoint heat fundamental solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0362 1. ch16:16.43\group Perelman Harnack

For a Ricci flow $g(t)$ and $\tau =T-t$, an adjoint heat kernel centered at $(x,0)$ solves \[ \left(\partial _\tau -\Delta +R\right)H=0, \qquad H(\cdot ,\tau )\longrightarrow \delta _x\quad (\tau \downarrow 0). \] Writing $H=(4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-f}$, set \[ v_H=\left(\tau (R+2\Delta f-|\nabla f|^2)+f-n\right)H. \]
